title: Concept: Request data bound wholesale (php) — review required
description: In php, extract($_POST) merges every request field into an object. Mass assignment turns hidden model attributes into client-writable inputs. The remedy is explicit binding via explicit variable assignment.
applicability: php request handlers binding input to models; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Privilege escalation via hidden fields (is_admin, role); MEDIUM severity, HIGH on account objects.
